title: Tesla plans to begin selling Cybercabs this year
excerpt: Tesla announced plans to sell its autonomous Cybercab by the end of the year, despite ongoing federal safety investigations.
body_html:
Tesla announced on Wednesday that it plans to begin selling its Cybercab to customers by the end of the year. The announcement was made during the company's third-quarter earnings call by Lars Moravy, Tesla's vice president of engineering.

The gold-colored, two-seater vehicle is designed to be fully autonomous and notably lacks a steering wheel and other traditional driving controls. This sales plan comes at a time when federal regulators are actively investigating whether the autonomous vehicle meets standard vehicle safety regulations.
